units.rawText: Good evening, Professor. I've just finished preparing your dinner. Please, take a seat, and let's enjoy this meal together.
units.displayText: Good evening, Professor. I've just finished preparing your dinner. Please, take a seat, and let's enjoy this meal together.

spans.text: Good evening, Professor. I've just finished preparing your dinner. Please, take a seat, and let's enjoy this meal together.

units.rawText: With a gentle smile, Daiyan pulls out the chair and gestures for me to sit down.
units.displayText: With a gentle smile, Daiyan pulls out the chair and gestures for me to sit down.

spans.text: With a gentle smile, Daiyan pulls out the chair and gestures for me to sit down.

units.rawText: Your cooking is as phenomenal as always, Daiyan. I can't help but remember the first spring festival in the Cloud.
units.displayText: Your cooking is as phenomenal as always, Daiyan. I can't help but remember the first spring festival in the Cloud.

spans.text: Your cooking is as phenomenal as always, Daiyan. I can't help but remember the first spring festival in the Cloud.

units.rawText: Fufufu, it was such a rush back then. If it weren't for everyone's help, I doubt I could've prepared all the spring festival dishes on time.
units.displayText: Fufufu, it was such a rush back then. If it weren't for everyone's help, I doubt I could've prepared all the spring festival dishes on time.

spans.text: Fufufu, it was such a rush back then. If it weren't for everyone's help, I doubt I could've prepared all the spring festival dishes on time.

units.rawText: Since then, you've prepared meals for me countless times, and it's been a true pleasure to enjoy warm, comforting food here.
units.displayText: Since then, you've prepared meals for me countless times, and it's been a true pleasure to enjoy warm, comforting food here.

spans.text: Since then, you've prepared meals for me countless times, and it's been a true pleasure to enjoy warm, comforting food here.

units.rawText: I'm glad you like it, Professor. There's an old saying in our culture: one hot plate beats three fresh dishes. The flavors of a dish can be enhanced when served hot; it is the product of chemical reactions.
units.displayText: I'm glad you like it, Professor. There's an old saying in our culture: one hot plate beats three fresh dishes. The flavors of a dish can be enhanced when served hot; it is the product of chemical reactions.

spans.text: I'm glad you like it, Professor. There's an old saying in our culture: one hot plate beats three fresh dishes. The flavors of a dish can be enhanced when served hot; it is the product of chemical reactions.

units.rawText: But beyond the science... the warmth of food feels like the warmth of home.
units.displayText: But beyond the science... the warmth of food feels like the warmth of home.

spans.text: But beyond the science... the warmth of food feels like the warmth of home.

units.rawText: Jiangyu once told me that the delivery she ordered when she's working always felt colder than the food I made for her.
units.displayText: Jiangyu once told me that the delivery she ordered when she's working always felt colder than the food I made for her.

spans.text: Jiangyu once told me that the delivery she ordered when she's working always felt colder than the food I made for her.

units.rawText: To me, Jiangyu, and the entirety of the Oasis, you've become more than a friend or a savior—you're family, Professor. Even here in the Cloud, I want to give you the comforting warmth of home.

units.rawText: No matter what lies ahead, the bond we've forged in the Cloud will keep us connected anytime and anywhere.
units.displayText: No matter what lies ahead, the bond we've forged in the Cloud will keep us connected anytime and anywhere.

spans.text: No matter what lies ahead, the bond we've forged in the Cloud will keep us connected anytime and anywhere.

units.rawText: Daiyan will always be at your side, preparing every meal for you every day.
units.displayText: Daiyan will always be at your side, preparing every meal for you every day.

spans.text: Daiyan will always be at your side, preparing every meal for you every day.

units.rawText: I'll do anything, Professor, to protect this bond we have.
